_meta.purpose: Tier assignment (A / B / C / Reject) for the Phase 4 dashboard.
_meta.spec_note: The original spec's section 11 was not supplied. These cut-offs are DERIVED. They are round numbers chosen to give a usable working split, not measured thresholds - change them freely.
_meta.rule: Tier is a pure function of total_score and confidence. No LLM judgement enters tiering.

tiers.label: Apply now
tiers.meaning: Strong match on the deterministic score. Worth a tailored CV and cover letter.
tiers.requires_confidence_note: A score above 70 built from too few scored components is capped at Tier B until the missing inputs are supplied, so a high number from thin evidence cannot masquerade as a strong match.

tiers.label: Worth considering
tiers.meaning: Decent match with real gaps. Apply if the pipeline is not full of Tier A.

tiers.label: Long shot
tiers.meaning: Weak match. Only worth it if something about the specific company matters to you.

tiers.label: Not worth applying
tiers.meaning: Scored, but too weak to justify the effort. Distinct from FILTERED, which never reached scoring at all.

filtered_tier.label: Rejected before scoring
filtered_tier.meaning: A hard filter in config/hard_filters.json excluded this posting. It has no score. The dashboard shows which rule fired and the text that triggered it, so a wrong filter is visible rather than invisible.

reason_generation.source: Reasons are assembled from the stored scoring breakdown - the actual component scores, matched and missing skills, and fired filter rules.
reason_generation.prohibited: No LLM-written generic encouragement. If a reason cannot be derived from a number in the breakdown, it is not shown.

why_worth_applying_rules.text: Skills line up: {matched_count} of {required_count} required skills matched, including {top_matched}.
Title is close to your target roles ({best_target_role}, {alignment_score}% similar).
{country_name} has a workable route for a Pakistani national ({visa_band}).
The posting explicitly mentions sponsorship or relocation support.
{country_name} scores {location_score}/100 on your English-language and Muslim-community preferences.
Your {candidate_years} documented years meet the {required_years} the posting asks for.

why_might_be_rejected_rules.text: Skill gap: missing {missing_count} required skills, including {top_missing}.
The posting asks for {required_years} years; {candidate_years} are documented.
Visa route into {country_name} is difficult for a Pakistani national ({visa_band}).
The posting appears to rule out sponsorship: "{visa_evidence}".
The posting asks for a {required_degree}; your highest is a Bachelor's.
Low confidence: {unscored_count} of 9 components could not be scored ({unscored_list}).
The title is some distance from your target roles - closest was {best_target_role} at {alignment_score}%.
